name: iaido draw-cut sword slash
rules: The character stays in place; both feet stay on the same pixels unless the pose says the front foot lunges.
The face pixels (eyes, mouth) are identical in every frame; the head stays upright.
The fox tail and the teal cloak lag one frame behind the body and swing opposite to its motion.

frames.pose: stance: the original pose, hand on the sword hilt at the hip
wind-up: knees bent 2 pixels lower, torso twisted back, hand gripping the hilt, the blade starting to leave the sheath
fast draw: the sword swept from the hip up and forward in a blur, arm extending
HIT: front foot lunged 3 pixels forward, sword arm fully extended forward with the blade slightly above horizontal, blade a little longer than natural
follow-through: blade continued down and forward past the target, body still lunged
recover: back toward the stance, sword returning to the sheath along a lower path
overshoot: the stance of cell 1 with the upper body 1 pixel further back
